constraints: Bind to 127.0.0.1 only. Refuse non-loopback remote/Host or cross-origin browser requests.
No live query/inference until an external config explicitly enables an approved time/call budget.
No static DAX, offline schema, result fixtures or fabricated LLM-answer fallback in the application.
Unknown users/questions/extra request fields rejected; raw DAX, role and customData not client parameters.
Cancel and clear all prior answers/results on persona changes. Discard stale in-flight responses.
DAX generation gets only the selected question and reviewed live IQ schema; explanation gets only the question and its current authorized rows.
No Foundry Agent Service or actual Power BI iframe in this increment. IQ provides schema, not a DAX-generation tool.
Native IQ ExecuteQuery and ValueSearch are never dispatched; custom query broker supplies all role/customData context.
Stream events reflect actual operation boundaries, never simulated progress or synthetic success.
No tokens, private keys, certificate material, raw service bodies or raw schema instruction/entitlement values are logged.
Do not label native result cards as an embedded Power BI report.
